evidence.name: Screen field: Style the price (top-right)
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Style the price (top-right)" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Style the price (top-right)
sections.description: Styles the top-right label on every plan card, usually the price: font, size, weight, color, alignment, and spacing, applied to all plans at once. The price value itself comes from the linked Stripe product, not here. Make the price bold and prominent so it's easy to compare across plans; theme defaults usually work.
